lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਰਦਾਯਉ ਉਲਟਿ ਗੰਗ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਧਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam rasan guramukh baradaayau ulat ga(n)g pascham dhareeaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru spoke the Lord's Name with His mouth and broadcast it throughout the world, to turn the tide of the hearts of men.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: soee naam achhal bhagatah bhav taaran amaradaas gur kau phuriaa ||1||
lines.translation: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਖੵ ਅਰੁ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarahi soee naam jakhy ar ki(n)nar saadhik sidh samaadh haraa ||
lines.translation: The gods and heavenly heralds, the Siddhas and seekers and Shiva in Samaadhi meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਅਵਰ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦਿ ਵਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarahi nakhytr avar dhroo ma(n)dal naaradaad prahalaad varaa ||
lines.translation: The stars and the realms of Dhroo, and devotees like Naaraad and Prahlaad meditate on the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਸੈਲ ਲੋਅ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saseear ar soor naam ulaasahi sail lo jin udhariaa ||
lines.translation: The moon and the sun long for the Naam; it has saved even mountain ranges.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: soee naam achhal bhagatah bhav taaran amaradaas gur kau phuriaa ||2||
lines.translation: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਵਰਿ ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸਮੁਧਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee naam sivar nav naath nira(n)jan siv sanakaad samudhariaa ||
lines.translation: Dwelling upon that Immaculate Naam, the nine Yogic masters, Shiva and Sanak and many others have been emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਵਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chavaraaseeh sidh budh jit raate a(n)bareek bhavajal tariaa ||
lines.translation: The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of supernatural spiritual powers, and the Buddhas are imbued with the Naam; it carried Ambreek across the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਧਉ ਅਕ੍ਰੂਰੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਲਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: udhau akroor tilochan naamaa kal kabeer kilavikh hariaa ||
lines.translation: It has erased the sins of Oodho, Akroor, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: soee naam achhal bhagatah bhav taaran amaradaas gur kau phuriaa ||3||
lines.translation: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit naam laag tetees dhiaavahi jatee tapeesur man vasiaa ||
lines.translation: The three hundred thirty million angels meditate, attached to the Naam; it is enshrined within the minds of the celibates and ascetics.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੰਗੇਵ ਪਿਤਾਮਹ ਚਰਣ ਚਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee naam simar ga(n)gev pitaamah charan chit a(n)mrit rasiaa ||
lines.translation: Bhisham Pitama, the son of the Ganges, meditated on that Naam; his consciousness delighted in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਧਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit naam guroo ga(n)bheer garoo mat sat kar sa(n)gat udhareeaa ||
lines.translation: The great and profound Guru has brought forth the Naam; accepting the teachings as true, the Holy Congregation has been saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: soee naam achhal bhagatah bhav taaran amaradaas gur kau phuriaa ||4||
lines.translation: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਵਿ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਸਾਖਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam kit sa(n)saar kiran rav suratar saakhah ||
lines.translation: The Glory of the Naam shines forth, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the Elysian Tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਤਰਿ ਦਖਿਣਿ ਪੁਬਿ ਦੇਸਿ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਾਖਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: utar dakhin pub des pascham jas bhaakhah ||
lines.translation: In the countries of the north, south, east and west, the Praises of the Naam are chanted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਸਕਯਥੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam ta ihu sakayath jit naam har ridai nivaasai ||
lines.translation: Life is fruitful, when the Name of the Lord abides in the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਆਸਾਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar gan ga(n)dharab chhi darasan aasaasai ||
lines.translation: The angelic beings, heavenly heralds, celestial singers and the six Shaastras yearn for the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧੁ ਤੇਜੋ ਤਨੌ ਕਲੵ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਧੵਾਇਅਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhalau prasidh tejo tanau kaly joR kar dhyaaiao ||
lines.translation: The son of Tayj Bhaan of the Bhalla dynasty is noble and famous; with his palms pressed together, KALL meditates on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਭਵਜਲ ਹਰਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: soee naam bhagat bhavajal haran gur amaradaas tai paaio ||5||
lines.translation: The Naam takes away the fears of the devotees about the word-ocean; Guru Amar Daas has obtained it. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨਰ ਨਾਮਿ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaavahi dev tetees ar saadhik sidh nar naam kha(n)d brahama(n)d dhaare ||
lines.translation: The thirty-one million gods meditate on the Naam, along with the Siddhas and seekers; the Naam supports solar systems and galaxies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਧਿਓ ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah naam samaadhio harakh sog sam kar sahaare ||
lines.translation: One who meditates on the Naam in Samaadhi, endures sorrow and joy as one and the same.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਰੋਮਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਭਗਤ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam siroman sarab mai bhagat rahe liv dhaar ||
lines.translation: The Naam is the most sublime of all; the devotees remain lovingly attuned to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮਰ ਗੁਰ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: soee naam padaarath amar gur tus deeo karataar ||6||
lines.translation: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the treasure of the Naam, by the Creator Lord, in His Pleasure. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸੂਰਉ ਸੀਲਿ ਬਲਵੰਤੁ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਘਨ ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat soorau seel balava(n)t sat bhaai sa(n)gat saghan garoo mat niravair leenaa ||
lines.translation: He is the Warrior Hero of Truth, humility is His Power. His Loving Nature inspires the Congregation with deep and profound understanding; He is absorbed in the Lord, free of hate and vengeance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਧਵਲੁ ਧੁਜਾ ਸੇਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਬੀਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis dheeraj dhur dhaval dhujaa set baiku(n)th beenaa ||
lines.translation: Patience has been His white banner since the beginning of time, planted on the bridge to heaven.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਜਿਹ ਕਰਤਾਰਹ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: parasahi sa(n)t piaar jih karataarah sa(n)jog ||
lines.translation: The Saints meet their Beloved Guru, who is united with the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਤਉ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: satiguroo sev sukh paaio amar gur keetau jog ||7||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, they find peace; Guru Amar Daas has given them this ability. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸ ਖਾਣੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਯ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਸ੍ਟ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam naavan naam ras khaan ar bhojan naam ras sadaa chaay mukh mist baanee ||
lines.translation: The Naam is His cleansing bath; the Naam is the food He eats; the Naam is the taste He enjoys. With deep yearning, He chants the Sweet Bani of the Guru's Word forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਸਾਇ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan satigur sevio jis pasaai gat agam jaanee ||
lines.translation: Blessed is service to the True Guru; by His Grace, the State of the Unfathomable Lord is known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸਮੁਧਰੇ ਪਾਯਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kul sa(n)booh samudhare paayau naam nivaas ||
lines.translation: All Your generations are totally saved; You dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
